## Built for business. Trusted by IT. Ready for AI.

Intelligent enterprises connect data, analytics, and AI across operations for faster, smarter
decisions. Ready to make the leap?

Alteryx One offers a clear path:


**Give teams an easy way to use enterprise data and AI while IT keeps control over security, scale,
and governance.**


**Reduce manual data prep time by up to 90%, automate analytics, and embed AI across the business.**


**Turn those data-backed decisions into impact with low-/no-code tools, AI assistance, and built-in
governance.**

[Discover Alteryx One][215]
Decision intelligence
Insights that drive action
Meaningful, measurable results
 
 

### Decision intelligence for executives

When the pressure’s on, you need to trust your data. Alteryx turns governed, AI-ready analytics into
insights you can stand behind, helping build an intelligent enterprise without the guesswork.

For executives, narrative cuts through the noise:
* [**Custom Reports**][216] explains the drivers, trends, and anomalies in clear language and
  updates as data changes.
* [**Auto Insights Playbooks**][217] surface high-value use cases from your own data and build
  reports in minutes, so you can test scenarios, choose trade-offs, and push actions to teams at
  enterprise scale.

[ Discover Generative AI ][218]
 
 

### Insights that drive action

Turn raw data into direction. Take advantage of 6 major platform integrations (Snowflake,
Databricks, AWS, Google, SAP, and Salesforce), along with 100+ prebuilt connectors and in-database
processing.

Analytic apps let business users run governed processes on demand, push results into downstream
systems, and collaborate in one view.

When AI knows your business, you get automation that allows for reliable decisions.

[ Get AI-Ready ][219]
 
 

### Meaningful, measurable results

Move from manual processes to proven impact. Transparent, governed workflows that standardize
analytics and reduce manual effort help you save time, cut millions in costs annually, and improve
efficiency at scale.

“What took my team almost a year to complete is now replicable and done in a matter of weeks.”

— Nikita Atkins, Data Science Global Leader, GHD

[ Start Now ][220]
 

## Capabilities that enable AI readiness at scale

Put data and AI to work for you. Connect systems, prep and blend data [**up to 100x faster**][221],
automate repeatable work, and keep lineage and controls in place. Alteryx One is a full-spectrum
analytics platform with 3 core capabilities that allow you to:

Prepare

Connect, clean, contextualize

Analyze

Explore, explain, share

Act

Forecast, simulate, operationalize

These capabilities have helped Alteryx users cut up to 70% of costs and save up to $2.2M annually.

 

[Discover Alteryx One][222]

### Data integration and AI-ready preparation

Create a unified view out of ERPs, CRMs, lakes, and files. Alteryx lets you connect enterprise apps
like Oracle and Microsoft without copying data. Automate prep with low-/no-code workflows, add
business context, and enforce governance and lineage to publish AI-ready datasets. Benefits include:
* Improved accuracy
* Faster analysis
* A single source of truth for teams

[Prepare Your Data][223]

## Built for business. Trusted by IT. Ready for AI.

Intelligent enterprises connect data, analytics, and AI across operations for faster, smarter
decisions. Ready to make the leap?

Alteryx One offers a clear path:


**Give teams an easy way to use enterprise data and AI while IT keeps control over security, scale,
and governance.**


**Reduce manual data prep time by up to 90%, automate analytics, and embed AI across the business.**


**Turn those data-backed decisions into impact with low-/no-code tools, AI assistance, and built-in
governance.**

[Discover Alteryx One][215]
Decision intelligence

### Decision intelligence for executives

When the pressure’s on, you need to trust your data. Alteryx turns governed, AI-ready analytics into
insights you can stand behind, helping build an intelligent enterprise without the guesswork.

For executives, narrative cuts through the noise:
* [**Custom Reports**][216] explains the drivers, trends, and anomalies in clear language and
  updates as data changes.
* [**Auto Insights Playbooks**][217] surface high-value use cases from your own data and build
  reports in minutes, so you can test scenarios, choose trade-offs, and push actions to teams at
  enterprise scale.

[ Discover Generative AI ][218]
 
 

### Insights that drive action

Turn raw data into direction. Take advantage of 6 major platform integrations (Snowflake,
Databricks, AWS, Google, SAP, and Salesforce), along with 100+ prebuilt connectors and in-database
processing.

Analytic apps let business users run governed processes on demand, push results into downstream
systems, and collaborate in one view.

When AI knows your business, you get automation that allows for reliable decisions.

[ Get AI-Ready ][219]
 
 

### Meaningful, measurable results

Move from manual processes to proven impact. Transparent, governed workflows that standardize
analytics and reduce manual effort help you save time, cut millions in costs annually, and improve
efficiency at scale.

“What took my team almost a year to complete is now replicable and done in a matter of weeks.”

— Nikita Atkins, Data Science Global Leader, GHD

[ Start Now ][220]
 

## Capabilities that enable AI readiness at scale

Put data and AI to work for you. Connect systems, prep and blend data [**up to 100x faster**][221],
automate repeatable work, and keep lineage and controls in place. Alteryx One is a full-spectrum
analytics platform with 3 core capabilities that allow you to:

Prepare

Connect, clean, contextualize

Analyze

Explore, explain, share

Act

Forecast, simulate, operationalize

These capabilities have helped Alteryx users cut up to 70% of costs and save up to $2.2M annually.

 

[Discover Alteryx One][222]

### Data integration and AI-ready preparation

Create a unified view out of ERPs, CRMs, lakes, and files. Alteryx lets you connect enterprise apps
like Oracle and Microsoft without copying data. Automate prep with low-/no-code workflows, add
business context, and enforce governance and lineage to publish AI-ready datasets. Benefits include:
* Improved accuracy
* Faster analysis
* A single source of truth for teams

# Crush your analytics goals with premium software and service

## We go the extra mile by working hand-in-hand with you to deliver exceptional, customizable
## reporting and data analytics, for game-changing insights.

[SEE WHY PEOPLE LOVE DUNDAS BI][59]
[Banner dashboard featuring dasboard by Dundas BI]
[Page Divider]

## Custom analytics experiences. Designed specifically for you.

## For mid-to-large enterprises

Hundreds of users of varying skillsets and countless disparate data sources? Leverage our enterprise
reporting and analytics platform, and empower all your users with powerful, easy-to-use analytics to
**make fact-based decisions from real-time insights**.

[ GET STARTED WITH ENTERPRISE ANALYTICS
   ⟶
][60]

## For software vendors

Embed world-class analytics into your product and bring your reporting and analytics vision to life.
Designed to scale, our product architecture, open APIs and flexible licensing structure ensure you
**maximize profits and bring your application to market faster**.

[ GET STARTED WITH EMBEDDED BI
   ⟶
][61]

## Your success is our passion

We’ve been helping businesses tap into their data to solve real business problems for over **25
years**. Our approach to providing **personalized, collaborative experiences** for all our customers
– from start to finish – is seen as the **benchmark for premium support and customer success**.

With Dundas, you get much more than great business intelligence and data analytics software. You get
a partner that ensures your success, every step of the way. **We solve problems. It’s as simple as
that**.

“Dundas BI’s HTML5 architecture allows virtually limitless flexibility and customization in creating
BI visualizations – backed by a company with a **proven track record in the industry and world class
support.**”

– Jeff Johnson, ADT

[SEE WHY PEOPLE LOVE DUNDAS BI][62]

## A revolutionary platform for all your business intelligence needs

Deliver an **unrivaled analytics experience** across the board, using the first fully programmable,
end-to-end BI platform of its kind.

Tailored to suit your specific use case, our flexible platform combines smart, interactive data
visualizations, open APIs, and rich, full-fledged BI capabilities for **effortless data analysis** –
all in one integrated platform.

“The only limit in Dundas BI is the limit you place on yourself. There really isn’t anything that
can’t be created in this **awesome software visualization package**.”

– Greg Stronsick, The Cleveland Clinic

[EXPLORE THE PLATFORM][63]

## Remove guesswork from the equation.

Let us show you how Dundas BI can help your business. Enjoy an open-ended and interactive discussion
tailored to your needs, led by a highly skilled business intelligence expert. It’s our engaging,
personal approach to understanding and solving your problem that sets us apart. **Don’t take it from
us - see for yourself why Dundas is a market leader**.

[GET A PERSONALIZED DEMO][64]

1,000+ companies trust Dundas to solve their biggest business challenges

## The 5 traps of enterprise AI and how to escape them

These aren’t new problems. They’re the same data governance failures enterprises have faced for 35
years, now running at AI speed. Strategy has watched this pattern repeat itself across thousands of
deployments. The difference today is the stakes: your AI agents are making decisions  at scale, not
just reporting on them. Mosaic was built to close these gaps at the infrastructure level.

[extension_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The context gap

When AI doesn’t know what your business means. AI doesn’t know that “churn” means something specific
at your company. Without a semantic layer, they guess and sound confident while being wrong.

**Mosaic injects your business logic into every AI query before it runs. The model doesn’t just see
your data; it understands what it means.**

[filter_alt_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The logic silo problem

Business rules your AI can’t reach. When metrics live inside BI tools and spreadsheets, AI
agents can’t access them. Every agent reinvents the math inconsistently. 

**Mosaic decouples logic from consumption. One semantic layer governs dashboards, agents, and
applications simultaneously. Define once, apply everywhere.**

[calculate_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The accuracy trap

Why you can’t ask AI to do math. AI and large language models excel at language. They fail at
aggregation. Asking one to calculate quarterly revenue is a reliable path to hallucinated numbers. 

**Strategy handles the computation. AI handles the explanation. Accurate answers in natural language
without the risk of a model doing math it wasn’t designed for.**

[encrypted_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The security blindspot

What your AI agent can see that it shouldn’t. Most AI data tools bypass row-level security entirely.
A model that can access your data can also summarize it for the wrong person. 

**Every query through Mosaic passes through your existing RBAC rules before a single byte is
fetched. Governed AI isn’t a setting. It’s the architecture.**

[trending_down_100dp_FA660F_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### The cost trap

How ungoverned AI queries drain your cloud budget. AI agents that query raw data tables directly are
expensive by design. Each iteration against millions of rows compounds your compute spend invisibly,
until the bill arrives.

**Mosaic’s Smart Caching and push-down optimization routes every query intelligently. Your cloud
costs reflect your decisions, not your agents’ inefficiency.**

Deploy agents that understand your definitions of revenue, churn, and risk, not generic

Business users query governed data directly, in natural language or through dashboards, with no risk

Replace Power BI, BOBJ, or Cognos without rebuilding your metrics. Business logic migrates to Mosaic

Embed governed intelligence into your product, customer portal, or internal app. without exposing

## FAQ

What is a universal semantic layer?

A universal semantic layer is the single source of truth for your organization's data definitions,
ensuring that 'Revenue' means exactly the same thing whether it's calculated in Salesforce, analyzed
in Tableau, or processed by your AI models. 

Sitting between your data sources and consumption tools, it translates raw data into trusted
business concepts like 'Active Customer' or 'Margin' with identical calculations and values
guaranteed across every team, every platform, and every use case.  

Unlike semantic layers trapped inside individual BI tools or data warehouses, a universal semantic
layer governs your entire data ecosystem, enforcing consistent definitions regardless of which
cloud, database, or application asks the question. No more finance reporting different numbers than
marketing. No more “Which dashboard is correct?”

How does Strategy Mosaic work?

Strategy Mosaic is a universal semantic layer that connects to your organization's data
sources: including Snowflake, Databrucks, BigQuery, Redshift, Azure, Synapse, SAP, Oracle,
Salesforce, Workday, and on-premises databases, without moving or replicating a single byte. 

Once connected, Mosaic Studio uses AI-powered modeling to automatically generate attributes,
hierarchies, and metrics from your data, delivering in hours what traditionally takes weeks of
manual work. Those definitions are then enforced across every connected BI tool, AI agent, and
application via SQL, DAX, MDX, and REST APIs: meaning Tableau, Power BI, Excel, and custom
applications all work from the same governed definitions automatically. 

Meanwhile, Mosaic Sentinel monitors your data ecosystem in real time, logging every access event,
flagging anomalies, detecting PII exposure, and maintaining a complete audit trail of who accessed
what data, when.

What are the benefits of Strategy Mosaic?
1. **Your Business Logic, Protected Across Every Platform and Every Change**: When your semantic
   layer is built into a single platform, your business definitions are only as portable as that
   vendor allows. Mosaic is a standalone, platform-agnostic layer that governs your definitions of
   Revenue, Margin, and Customer identically across every tool, every cloud, and every AI agent. And
   unlike newer semantic layer tools, Mosaic is backed by 35+ years of enterprise semantic
   technology, meaning it handles the complexity of real enterprise data: fiscal calendars,
   multi-currency hierarchies, time transformations, and security models that most tools are still
   building toward. Your logic is protected today, and it will still be intact when your
   infrastructure changes tomorrow. 
2. **The Only Semantic Layer Built for Everyone, Not Just Engineers**: Most semantic layers are
   built for data engineers and require SQL, YAML, or code to use. Mosaic Studio lets business users
   define new metrics in plain language, build and modify models without writing a single line of
   code, and govern data without filing a ticket. When business users can own their own definitions,
   your data team stops being a bottleneck and starts being a strategic asset. 
3. **Governance That Scales as Fast as Your AI:** As AI agents proliferate across your organization,
   the question isn't just "is my data accurate?" it's "Do I know what my AI accessed, at what cost,
   and whether it touched sensitive data?" Mosaic Sentinel answers all three in real time. It's the
   only semantic layer with governance intelligence built natively into the platform, not added
   on after the fact, giving you the confidence to scale AI without scaling risk.

How does Strategy Mosaic compare to semantic layers built into Snowflake or Databricks?

Snowflake and Databricks are exceptional data platforms. But their semantic layers are built to keep
you inside their ecosystem. Definitions created there don't travel cleanly to Tableau, Power BI, or
your AI agents without custom work.

Mosaic sits above your data platforms as an independent layer. Your definitions of Revenue, Margin,
and Customer are governed identically whether the query comes from a BI tool, an AI agent, or a
Python

#### From metric to action, in any interface

Because the semantic layer sits beneath every tool, the same governed logic powers dashboards, AI
agents, conversational queries, and embedded applications. One truth. Every surface.

[trending_down_100dp_000000_FILL0_wght400_GRAD0_opsz48.svg]

#### Infrastructure-grade query efficiency

Mosaic’s push-down optimization and Smart Caching eliminate redundant processing at the source. The
result is predictable cloud spend even as AI query volume scales.

[Explore Mosaic][14]

## What gets built when AI has a governed foundation 

Strategy Mosaic is the semantic layer that enterprise teams deploy once and build on
indefinitely. Here’s what becomes possible when your AI operates from a single, trusted source of
truth. 

**AI Agents with business context** 

Deploy agents that understand your definitions of revenue, churn, and risk, not generic
approximations. Built on Mosaic, agents use the same logic as your dashboards. 

**Self-service analytics at enterprise scale** 

Business users query governed data directly, in natural language or through dashboards, with no risk
of conflicting metrics or unauthorized access. 

**BI tool migration without logic loss** 

Replace Power BI, BOBJ, or Cognos without rebuilding your metrics. Business logic migrates to Mosaic
once then powers any BI tool you choose. 

**Embedded analytics in any application** 

Embed governed intelligence into your product, customer portal, or internal app. without exposing
the underlying data model or rebuilding access controls. 

## The semantic layer that connects your entire data ecosystem 

Strategy Mosaic sits beneath your existing stack, not on top of it. With 200+ native connectors to
every major cloud, warehouse, and lakehouse, governed semantics deploy instantly across Databricks,
Snowflake, Google BigQuery, Azure Synapse, and beyond. No migration. No lock-in. Your data stays
where it is.

## FAQ

What is a universal semantic layer?

A universal semantic layer is the single source of truth for your organization's data definitions,
ensuring that 'Revenue' means exactly the same thing whether it's calculated in Salesforce, analyzed
in Tableau, or processed by your AI models. 

Sitting between your data sources and consumption tools, it translates raw data into trusted
business concepts like 'Active Customer' or 'Margin' with identical calculations and values
guaranteed across every team, every platform, and every use case.  

Unlike semantic layers trapped inside individual BI tools or data warehouses, a universal semantic
layer governs your entire data ecosystem, enforcing consistent definitions regardless of which
cloud, database, or application asks the question. No more finance reporting different numbers than
marketing. No more “Which dashboard is correct?”

How does Strategy Mosaic work?

Strategy Mosaic is a universal semantic layer that connects to your organization's data
sources: including Snowflake, Databrucks, BigQuery, Redshift, Azure, Synapse, SAP, Oracle,
Salesforce, Workday, and on-premises databases, without moving or replicating a single byte. 

Once connected, Mosaic Studio uses AI-powered modeling to automatically generate attributes,
hierarchies, and metrics from your data, delivering in hours what traditionally takes weeks of
manual work. Those definitions are then enforced across every connected BI tool, AI agent, and
application via SQL, DAX, MDX, and REST APIs: meaning Tableau, Power BI, Excel, and custom
applications all work from the same governed definitions automatically. 

Meanwhile, Mosaic Sentinel monitors your data ecosystem in real time, logging every access event,
flagging anomalies, detecting PII exposure, and maintaining a complete audit trail of who accessed
what data, when.

What are the benefits of Strategy Mosaic?
1. **Your Business Logic, Protected Across Every Platform and Every Change**: When your semantic
   layer is built into a single platform, your business definitions are only as portable as that
   vendor allows. Mosaic is a standalone, platform-agnostic layer that governs your definitions of
   Revenue, Margin, and Customer identically across every tool, every cloud, and every AI agent. And
   unlike newer semantic layer tools, Mosaic is backed by 35+ years of enterprise semantic
   technology, meaning it handles the complexity of real enterprise data: fiscal calendars,
   multi-currency hierarchies, time transformations, and security models that most tools are still
   building toward. Your logic is protected today, and it will still be intact when your
   infrastructure changes tomorrow. 
2. **The Only Semantic Layer Built for Everyone, Not Just Engineers**: Most semantic layers are
   built for data engineers and require SQL, YAML, or code to use. Mosaic Studio lets business users
   define new metrics in plain language, build and modify models without writing a single line of
   code, and govern data without filing a ticket. When business users can own their own definitions,
   your data team stops being a bottleneck and starts being a strategic asset. 
3. **Governance That Scales as Fast as Your AI:** As AI agents proliferate across your organization,
   the question isn't just "is my data accurate?" it's "Do I know what my AI accessed, at what cost,
   and whether it touched sensitive data?" Mosaic Sentinel answers all three in real time. It's the
   only semantic layer with governance intelligence built natively into the platform, not added
   on after the fact, giving you the confidence to scale AI without scaling risk.

How does Strategy Mosaic compare to semantic layers built into Snowflake or Databricks?

Snowflake and Databricks are exceptional data platforms. But their semantic layers are built to keep
you inside their ecosystem. Definitions created there don't travel cleanly to Tableau, Power BI, or
your AI agents without custom work.

Mosaic sits above your data platforms as an independent layer. Your definitions of Revenue, Margin,
and Customer are governed identically whether the query comes from a BI tool, an AI agent, or a

* ## Oracle Cloud Infrastructure
  
  Oracle offers the highest-performing cloud services at the lowest cost. That's why so many of the
  world's biggest technology companies use OCI.
  
  **OCI Tech Customers**
  
  AMD, ByteDance, Meta, NVIDIA, OpenAI, Temu, TikTok, Uber, xAI
  
  The demand for cloud infrastructure for AI training and inferencing greatly exceeds supply. In
  response to this shortage, Oracle is building AI cloud capacity as quickly as we can.
  
  [Learn more][22]
  [Oracle Cloud Infrastructure]
  
  ### Building the World's Largest AI Cloud
  
  1.2 billion watt Texas data center | 500,000 NVIDIA GPUs
* [MultiCloud Database]
  
  ### Oracle AI Database in 200+ Data Centers
  
  Multicloud: 22@AWS, 15@Google, 33@Azure and 135@Oracle Cloud
  
  ## Multicloud AI Database
  
  Oracle AI Database in every cloud
  
  Amazon · Google · Microsoft · Oracle
  
  **Most Advanced Database Technology**
  
  Oracle’s Autonomous and AI Database software running on high-performance Exadata hardware is
  available in Amazon, Google, Microsoft, and Oracle Cloud data centers all over the world.
  
  Pick the cloud you want to use.
  
  Get the same low price everywhere.
  
  [Learn more][23]
* ## AI Data Platform
  
  **AI Models in Oracle Cloud**
  
  Google Gemini, Meta Llama, OpenAI ChatGPT, xAI Grok, and more . . .
  
  **AI Data Catalog**
  
  Unifies all your private structured and unstructured data without moving it – by using the AI Data
  Platform's Data Catalog
  
  [Get started with AI Data Catalog][24]
  
  **AI Data Platform Workbench**
  
  An end-to-end Integrated Development Environment for building any type of AI Application – chat,
  multistep agents, transactions, workflows – on all your data
  
  [Get started with AI Data Platform Workbench][25]
  
  [Learn More][26]
  [AI Data Platform with Multimodal AI models, Public Data and Private Data Lakehouse]
  
  ### AI models reason on private data
  
  All private data unified in data catalog
* [Cloud@Customer]
  
  ### All OCI Services in 3 Racks
  
  Installed in your data center from $250,000 per month
  
  ## Cloud@Customer
  
  **All OCI Services and Applications**
  
  Put the entire Oracle Cloud inside your data center. Cloud@Customer includes every Oracle
  infrastructure service and application. Your data and network traffic stay secure and private
  inside your data center and behind your firewall.
  
  **Enable AI on your Private Data**
  
  Now you can do AI inferencing and multistep reasoning on your private data while keeping that data
  private.
  
  [Learn more][27]
* ## Fusion Applications
  
  Fusion is the only application suite that brings AI to every aspect of your business:

# Connecting your enterprise, igniting its INTELLIGENCE

Backed by 25 years of continuous modernization, TIBCO’s real-time, AI-enabled composable platform
connects your enterprise, amplifying its intelligence for smarter, faster decisions.

[EXPLORE THE TIBCO PLATFORM][35]

## Accelerate with AI and
## INTELLIGENT AUTOMATION

Drive modernization with our cloud-native, real-time, [AI-enabled][36] composable data platform

[LEARN MORE][37]
* **MCP servers**
  
  Expose capabilities via MCP Server and custom Zero-Code MCP Server. By enabling user functions
  without heavy development, TIBCO provides a unified [AI platform][38].
* [**AI-driven insights***][39]
  
  [Unlock AI-powered insights*][40] for your applications: messaging, data, or platform-level. With
  integrated vector databases and advanced analytics, TIBCO transforms raw data into actionable
  intelligence.
* **Copilots and zero-code agents**
  
  Empower teams with [AI copilots*][41], app-development aids, and low-code templates to accelerate
  innovation. TIBCO enables business users and developers to build powerful, intelligent
  applications helping to democratize AI.
* **AI accelerators**
  
  Move from concept to reality quickly with features such as an AI-powered mapper and dedicated AI
  palette. With these advanced AI accelerators, TIBCO helps to fast-track development, reduce
  effort, and deliver outcomes sooner.

## The TIBCO®
## PLATFORM

The [AI-powered platform][42] for real-time
operations and insights

## Capabilities

[

### INTEGRATION

][43]

### **Integration**
* Connect applications, data, and devices with our industry-leading integration platform
* Accelerate integration projects with prebuilt connectors and low-code tools

[EXPLORE INTEGRATION SOLUTIONS][44]
[

### MESSAGING

][45]

### **Messaging**
* Enable scalable, real-time messaging for complex enterprise integrations
* Ensure reliable messaging across cloud, IoT, mobile, and web

[EXPLORE MESSAGING SOLUTIONS][46]
[

### DATA GRID

][47]

### **Data Grid**

visual analytics, then share insights securely–without any need to manage servers or infrastructure.

A self-hosted analytics platform, to gain full control of your data and analytics deployment,
whether implementing on your own infrastructure or in the cloud (private and public instances).

[ Talk to an expert ][72]

An open analytics platform that combines AI, trusted data, modular architecture, and direct workflow
integration, to turn insights into actions faster and smarter than ever.

A governed, flexible environment, to explore, model, and visualize data anytime anywhere–even

answers inside the tools they already use, without switching context or copying screenshots.

תוך המרת עבודה ידנית בכלים אוטומטיים

[From data to knowledge]

### מנתונים למידע ובקרה

שדרוג תהליכים של עבודה עם נתונים לכלים המאפשרים לקבל תובנות ומידע בעל ערך על בסיס נתונים

[SEO]

### שיפור ביצועים עסקיים

אפליקציות לתמיכה בתהליכי קבלת החלטות מאפשרות גישה שיטתית בתכנון עסקי ויכולת התגובה לתנאי שוק משתנים

בזכות המחויבות, המקצועיות, הניסיון והתוצאות

[From data to knowledge]

חברת אניפיט בע"מ מספקת פתרונות וכלים ממוחשבים עבור איסוף, ניהול וניתוח נתונים בהתאם לצרכי הלקוחות
ופתרונות בינה עסקית בסביבת מייקרוסופט. חברת אניפיט צברה במהלך השנים ניסיון רב בתחום פיתוח
באופיס וביצעה עשרות רבות של פרויקטים המשמשים לקוחות מכל גודל ומגזר עסקי. כמו כן, מתנהל באתר פורום
חינמי למען קהילת משתמשי האופיס לשאלות ותשובות להעשרת הידע באופיס.

HP, מנהל שרשרת אספקה: "AnyFit הינה חברה בעלת מחויבות גבוהה ללקוח, הם מגיבים מהר ומבצעים את העבודה
בצורה מקצועית..."

[From data to knowledge]

## Our purpose

For nearly 200 years, we've supported and advocated for our members to ensure New South Wales
remains the best place in Australia to do business.

Your voice matters.** **That’s why we listen closely through [surveys][99], forums, and direct
engagement to understand the *real* challenges businesses face.

Guided by your insights, our experts develop practical policy solutions and present them to
government through [evidence-based papers][100], [official press releases][101],
and [submissions][102].

Some of the issues we advocate for include red tape reduction, business taxation, workforce skills,
workplace relations, WHS, and more .



[Learn more about our advocacy][103]

# Welcome to Channel Dive

It’s a new day for tech channel news at Industry Dive and Informa TechTarget.

Published Oct. 30, 2025
[ [Phil Harvey's headshot] ][27]
[Phil Harvey][28] Editor-in-Chief

Pelicans fly over the Salton Sea at sunrise on July 7, 2011, in Salton City, California. David McNew
via Getty Images

Welcome to Channel Dive.

We're Informa TechTarget's new publication, focused on delivering daily news and analysis for
executives at North American channel partners — the diverse ecosystem of companies that resell,
deliver and add value to technology products and services. 

The [business combination][37] of [Industry Dive][38], the Informa Tech media brands, and TechTarget
provided us with the opportunity to assemble new teams and implement positive changes in our
approach to this market. 

We've sunset the [Channel Futures brand and website][39] and launched [Channel Dive][40] to provide
solid, dependable reporting to channel partners, while making it as easy as possible for them to
follow the topics that matter most. 

The seven newsletters previously sent by Channel Futures have been consolidated into a single [daily
newsletter][41], now available at Channel Dive. We aim to make the Channel Dive Daily as helpful and
uncluttered as possible. 

We took a similar approach with the Channel Dive website, featuring a highly functional and
minimalist design. We believe our audience will appreciate the absence of clickbait slideshows and
shouty headlines labeling every exec who changes jobs a "superstar." 

The [Channel Dive team][42] will feature reporting by Channel Futures alum James Anderson and Senior
Editor Matt Ashare, previously of CIO Dive, along with contributions from writers you've read before
on Channel Futures and other Industry Dive publications. The team will be managed by me, in addition
to my [daily editorial duties][43] at Light Reading.

Our goal is to earn your trust as a fair and valuable source of daily news and insights for channel
professionals. Let us know how we're doing and what issues you'd like us to cover next at
[[email protected]][44].

# Welcome to Channel Dive

It’s a new day for tech channel news at Industry Dive and Informa TechTarget.

Published Oct. 30, 2025
[ [Phil Harvey's headshot] ][27]
[Phil Harvey][28] Editor-in-Chief

Pelicans fly over the Salton Sea at sunrise on July 7, 2011, in Salton City, California. David McNew
via Getty Images

Welcome to Channel Dive.

We're Informa TechTarget's new publication, focused on delivering daily news and analysis for
executives at North American channel partners — the diverse ecosystem of companies that resell,
deliver and add value to technology products and services. 

The [business combination][37] of [Industry Dive][38], the Informa Tech media brands, and TechTarget
provided us with the opportunity to assemble new teams and implement positive changes in our
approach to this market. 

We've sunset the [Channel Futures brand and website][39] and launched [Channel Dive][40] to provide
solid, dependable reporting to channel partners, while making it as easy as possible for them to
follow the topics that matter most. 

The seven newsletters previously sent by Channel Futures have been consolidated into a single [daily
newsletter][41], now available at Channel Dive. We aim to make the Channel Dive Daily as helpful and
uncluttered as possible. 

We took a similar approach with the Channel Dive website, featuring a highly functional and
minimalist design. We believe our audience will appreciate the absence of clickbait slideshows and
shouty headlines labeling every exec who changes jobs a "superstar." 

The [Channel Dive team][42] will feature reporting by Channel Futures alum James Anderson and Senior
Editor Matt Ashare, previously of CIO Dive, along with contributions from writers you've read before
on Channel Futures and other Industry Dive publications. The team will be managed by me, in addition
to my [daily editorial duties][43] at Light Reading.

Our goal is to earn your trust as a fair and valuable source of daily news and insights for channel
professionals. Let us know how we're doing and what issues you'd like us to cover next at
[[email protected]][44].

### Built to Integrate. Designed to Scale

With intelligent system design and secure integration, we help you simplify operations, increase
agility, and unlock growth.

[ LET'S TALK ][62]

## Core Capabilities Flexible by Design

Explore how Cortexus delivers secure, scalable, and purpose-built systems designed to integrate,
automate, and accelerate your operations.

## Custom Applications

Tailored business apps built for performance, usability, and scale on web, mobile, or desktop.

[ Learn More ][63]

## System Integration

Connecting your tools, platforms, and data to work together as a unified ecosystem.

[ Learn More ][64]

## Automation & Workflows

Smart automations designed to save time, reduce errors, and boost team productivity.

[ Learn More ][65]

## Cloud Architecture

Secure, scalable cloud environments designed for agility, resilience, and cost-efficiency.

[ Learn More ][66]

## Cybersecurity

Secure-by-design systems with access control, monitoring, and compliance baked in.

[ Learn More ][67]

## Data & Business Intelligence

Turning raw data into clarity, giving you insights to optimise operations and make smarter
decisions.

[ Learn More ][68]

## IT Strategy & Support

Advisory, implementation, and ongoing support focused on outcomes, not just tickets.

[ Learn More ][69]

## How We Work

## Our Approach, Built Around You

## 1. Understand Your Business

We learn how you work so we can deliver systems that work for you.

## 2. Design the Right Solution

From integration to automation, every solution is tailored for usability, performance, and scale.

## 3. Build & Launch

We deliver scalable systems that are secure, reliable, and ready from day one.

## 4. Support & Evolve

After going live, we stay close, refining, supporting, and scaling as your business grows.

## ABOUT US

Smart systems. 

Built for real business.

We create custom-built systems and integrations that streamline operations, enhance performance, and
scale with you.


We work across industries to simplify complexity and empower teams  with clarity, structure, and
security at the core.
* No tech buzzwords. Just practical results.
* Full ownership. Long-term value.
* Trusted by ops, IT, and growing companies.

[ Learn More ][70]

### Built to Integrate. Designed to Scale

With intelligent system design and secure integration, we help you simplify operations, increase
agility, and unlock growth.

[ LET'S TALK ][62]

## Core Capabilities Flexible by Design

Explore how Cortexus delivers secure, scalable, and purpose-built systems designed to integrate,
automate, and accelerate your operations.

## Custom Applications

Tailored business apps built for performance, usability, and scale on web, mobile, or desktop.

[ Learn More ][63]

## System Integration

Connecting your tools, platforms, and data to work together as a unified ecosystem.

[ Learn More ][64]

## Automation & Workflows

Smart automations designed to save time, reduce errors, and boost team productivity.

[ Learn More ][65]

## Cloud Architecture

Secure, scalable cloud environments designed for agility, resilience, and cost-efficiency.

[ Learn More ][66]

## Cybersecurity

Secure-by-design systems with access control, monitoring, and compliance baked in.

[ Learn More ][67]

## Data & Business Intelligence

Turning raw data into clarity, giving you insights to optimise operations and make smarter
decisions.

[ Learn More ][68]

## IT Strategy & Support

Advisory, implementation, and ongoing support focused on outcomes, not just tickets.

[ Learn More ][69]

## How We Work

## Our Approach, Built Around You

## 1. Understand Your Business

We learn how you work so we can deliver systems that work for you.

## 2. Design the Right Solution

From integration to automation, every solution is tailored for usability, performance, and scale.

## 3. Build & Launch

We deliver scalable systems that are secure, reliable, and ready from day one.

## 4. Support & Evolve

After going live, we stay close, refining, supporting, and scaling as your business grows.

## ABOUT US

Smart systems. 

Built for real business.

We create custom-built systems and integrations that streamline operations, enhance performance, and
scale with you.


We work across industries to simplify complexity and empower teams  with clarity, structure, and
security at the core.
* No tech buzzwords. Just practical results.
* Full ownership. Long-term value.
* Trusted by ops, IT, and growing companies.

[ Learn More ][70]

## WHERE WE ARE LOCATED

## Let’s build what’s next. Together

## Not sure where to start? That’s okay.
## We’re here to help you figure it out and build what’s needed to move forward.

## Build and run apps, agents

### The Databricks Platform

Unify your data, analytics and AI. Use it to power agents, apps and natural language insights.

[Explore the platform][85]

### Modern applications need a lakebase

A lakebase delivers the unified transactional layer that ties together your data, AI and governance,
making it easy to build, deploy and manage production applications on a single platform.

[Explore Lakebase][86]

### Build AI agents that work in the real world

The best AI isn’t just smart — it works for your business. Build high-quality, production-ready AI
agents grounded in your data.

[Explore Agent Bricks][87]

### Intelligent analytics for all

The next generation of analytics is here. From natural language dashboard creation to deep
conversational analytics with Genie, this is BI built on AI from the start. Now, everyone can
explore data and uncover insights.

[Explore AI/BI][88]

### Govern data and AI on one platform

Maintain compliance across data, models, dashboards and agents. Get deeper insight into your data
all in one unified, open governance layer.

[Explore Unity Catalog][89]

### The best warehouse is still a lakehouse

Eliminate legacy warehouse costs and lower TCO with an open, intelligent data warehouse.

[Explore Lakehouse][90]

### Build better data pipelines faster

Build reliable ETL pipelines for batch and streaming with Lakeflow. Ingest, transform and
orchestrate your data at scale with a unified solution.

[Explore Lakeflow][91]

THE DATABRICKS PLATFORM

## Build and run apps, agents
## and AI on your data

PlatformDatabaseAIBusiness intelligenceGovernanceData warehousingData engineering

### The Databricks Platform

Unify your data, analytics and AI. Use it to power agents, apps and natural language insights.

[Explore the platform][85]

### Modern applications need a lakebase

A lakebase delivers the unified transactional layer that ties together your data, AI and governance,
making it easy to build, deploy and manage production applications on a single platform.

[Explore Lakebase][86]

### Build AI agents that work in the real world

The best AI isn’t just smart — it works for your business. Build high-quality, production-ready AI
agents grounded in your data.

[Explore Agent Bricks][87]

### Intelligent analytics for all

The next generation of analytics is here. From natural language dashboard creation to deep
conversational analytics with Genie, this is BI built on AI from the start. Now, everyone can
explore data and uncover insights.

[Explore AI/BI][88]

### Govern data and AI on one platform

Maintain compliance across data, models, dashboards and agents. Get deeper insight into your data
all in one unified, open governance layer.

[Explore Unity Catalog][89]

### The best warehouse is still a lakehouse

Eliminate legacy warehouse costs and lower TCO with an open, intelligent data warehouse.

[Explore Lakehouse][90]

### Build better data pipelines faster

Build reliable ETL pipelines for batch and streaming with Lakeflow. Ingest, transform and
orchestrate your data at scale with a unified solution.

[Explore Lakeflow][91]

# Turning news
# and data into decisions

Dow Jones delivers trusted news, data, and intelligence to help leaders see clearly, act quickly,
and move confidently.

Business News

## The world’s source for business news and
## market insight

Grounded in facts, shaped by experience, and defined by editorial standards that don’t waver.

##### Premium news for decisions that matter, in business and in life. Get the facts, follow
##### the markets, and see what’s coming with trusted reporting and expert analysis.

[Explore all publications][183]

Business solutions

## Data, analytics, and reporting built for
## business decisions

Empowering businesses with premium data, AI-driven analytics, and actionable insights to ensure
regulatory compliance, inform strategic decisions, and drive growth in competitive markets.

[Explore all business solutions][184]
[

### Risk Management

Ensure compliance and manage regulatory and reputational risk with best-in-class, reliable and
actionable data and platforms.

Explore risk management
][185]
[

Leading news, data, and analysis for energy, chemical, and environmental markets worldwide.

Explore energy markets
][186]

Power strategic decisions with news, information and business intelligence, enhanced by the power of
GenAI.

Explore corporate research
][187]

### Investment Data

Strengthen financial decisions by leveraging trusted real-time news, data and analysis.

Explore investment data
][188]

When every move counts, you need experience, speed, and scale you can trust.

70M+

700+

AI specialists build the models powering next-generation intelligence

Of signals are monitored daily to keep you ahead of what’s next

Global sources feed the most complete view of business and markets

11,500+

Companies are tracked in real time for actionable corporate events

The WSJ Leadership Institute is a members-only network of the world’s most influential leaders
across industries, sectors, and borders. Join the community shaping what’s next in business,
technology, and culture.

Our global conferences, special interest forums, and exclusive experiences are designed to move
conversations forward and turn ideas into real-world impact.

[Winkelwagen][73] verlating blijft een van de meest hardnekkige uitdagingen in ecommerce, met

## Misyon, Vizyon ve *Değerlerimiz*

Kurulduğumuz günden bu yana müşterilerimizin dijital dönüşüm yolculuğunda güvenilir teknoloji ortağı
olmak için çalışıyoruz.

Misyonumuz

### Misyonumuz

Paydaşlarımız için sürdürülebilir büyümeyi ve başarıyı teşvik ederken, aynı zamanda gelecek nesiller
için yaşanabilir bir dünya bırakma misyonuyla ekosistemimize ilham kaynağı olmak.

Vizyonumuz

### Vizyonumuz

Kalıcı ve katma değer üreten teknoloji çözümleri ile dijital dönüşüm süreçlerini desteklerken, esnek
ve özelleştirilebilir ürün ve hizmetlerle sektörde fark yaratmak. Müşteri memnuniyeti odaklı
yaklaşımımız, yüksek kalite standartlarımız ve küresel pazara liderlik eden iş ortaklarımız ile
ulusal pazarda olduğu kadar uluslararası alanda da konumumuzu güçlendirmek.

Dijital Teknolojiler

## Endüstri 4.0 *Ekosistemi*

**Fabrikaların Geleceği MAS+ ile Şekilleniyor**

MAS+, işletmelerin yalnızca bugünkü üretim ihtiyaçlarını değil, gelecekteki dijital dönüşüm
hedeflerini de destekleyen kapsamlı bir Akıllı Fabrika Platformudur.

Veriyi görünür kılan, süreçleri optimize eden ve karar mekanizmalarını güçlendiren MAS+ ile
üretiminizi geleceğe taşıyın.

**Üretimin Dijital Geleceğini Bugünden Yönetin**

Günümüz üretim dünyasında rekabet artık yalnızca daha fazla üretmekle değil; daha verimli, daha
esnek, daha sürdürülebilir ve daha akıllı üretmekle mümkün hale gelmiştir. Küresel rekabetin
arttığı, müşteri beklentilerinin değiştiği ve teknolojik dönüşümün hızlandığı bu yeni dönemde üretim
tesislerinin gerçek zamanlı veri ile yönetilmesi kritik önem taşımaktadır.

MAS+, üretim operasyonlarının dijitalleştirilmesi, görünür hale getirilmesi ve sürekli
iyileştirilmesi amacıyla geliştirilmiş yeni nesil Akıllı Fabrika Platformudur.

Üretim sahasındaki makinelerden, operatörlerden ve kurumsal sistemlerden elde edilen verileri tek
bir platform altında bir araya getirerek işletmelere uçtan uca dijital üretim yönetimi imkanı sunar.

MAS+, yalnızca verileri toplamakla kalmaz; üretimi analiz eder, süreçleri optimize eder, karar alma
mekanizmalarını güçlendirir ve işletmelerin dijital dönüşüm yolculuğuna liderlik eder.

MAS+ İle Neler Kazanırsınız?

Üretim tesisleri her gün binlerce veri üretmektedir. Ancak bu verilerin anlamlı bilgiye
dönüştürülememesi, işletmelerin önemli fırsatları kaçırmasına neden olmaktadır.
MAS+, üretim sahasını dijitalleştirerek;
• Operasyonel görünürlüğü artırır
• Verimlilik kayıplarını ortaya çıkarır
• Üretim performansını ölçülebilir hale getirir
• Kalite süreçlerini güçlendirir
• İzlenebilirliği artırır
• Kaynak kullanımını optimize eder
• Karar alma süreçlerini hızlandırır
Böylece işletmeler yalnızca geçmişi raporlamak yerine üretim süreçlerini gerçek zamanlı yönetebilir.

Üretimin Dijital Omurgası

MAS+, ERP, CRM, APS, SCADA, PLC, IoT cihazları ve diğer kurumsal sistemlerle entegre çalışarak
üretimin dijital omurgasını oluşturur.
Makine seviyesinden yönetim katına kadar tüm operasyonların tek platform üzerinden izlenmesini ve
yönetilmesini sağlar.
Bu bütünleşik yapı sayesinde işletmeler;
• Tek noktadan veri yönetimi
• Gerçek zamanlı operasyon takibi
• Bölümler arası veri bütünlüğü
• Hızlı karar alma
• Süreç standardizasyonu
gibi önemli kazanımlar elde eder.

MAS+ Çözüm Ailesi Üretim Yönetimi

Üretim Yönetimi
Üretim emirlerinin, operasyonların ve iş istasyonlarının merkezi olarak yönetilmesini sağlar.
Üretim süreçleri anlık olarak takip edilir, gerçekleşen üretim miktarları izlenir ve üretim
performansı ölçülür.

• Gerçek zamanlı üretim takibi

• İş istasyonu yönetimi
• Operasyon kontrolü
• Üretim performans analizi

OEE ve Verimlilik Yönetimi

Üretim tesislerinin verimlilik seviyelerinin ölçülmesini ve iyileştirilmesini sağlar.
Makine duruşları, hız kayıpları ve kalite kayıpları analiz edilerek verimlilik artırıcı aksiyonlar
belirlenir.

**Kalite Yönetimi**
Kalite süreçlerinin dijital ortamda yönetilmesini ve üretim boyunca kalite kontrol mekanizmalarının

Ürün kalitesinin artırılması ve hataların kaynağında önlenmesi hedeflenir.

## Misyon, Vizyon ve *Değerlerimiz*

Kurulduğumuz günden bu yana müşterilerimizin dijital dönüşüm yolculuğunda güvenilir teknoloji ortağı
olmak için çalışıyoruz.

Misyonumuz

### Misyonumuz

Paydaşlarımız için sürdürülebilir büyümeyi ve başarıyı teşvik ederken, aynı zamanda gelecek nesiller
için yaşanabilir bir dünya bırakma misyonuyla ekosistemimize ilham kaynağı olmak.

Vizyonumuz

### Vizyonumuz

Kalıcı ve katma değer üreten teknoloji çözümleri ile dijital dönüşüm süreçlerini desteklerken, esnek
ve özelleştirilebilir ürün ve hizmetlerle sektörde fark yaratmak. Müşteri memnuniyeti odaklı
yaklaşımımız, yüksek kalite standartlarımız ve küresel pazara liderlik eden iş ortaklarımız ile
ulusal pazarda olduğu kadar uluslararası alanda da konumumuzu güçlendirmek.

Dijital Teknolojiler

## Endüstri 4.0 *Ekosistemi*

**Fabrikaların Geleceği MAS+ ile Şekilleniyor**

MAS+, işletmelerin yalnızca bugünkü üretim ihtiyaçlarını değil, gelecekteki dijital dönüşüm
hedeflerini de destekleyen kapsamlı bir Akıllı Fabrika Platformudur.

Veriyi görünür kılan, süreçleri optimize eden ve karar mekanizmalarını güçlendiren MAS+ ile
üretiminizi geleceğe taşıyın.

**Üretimin Dijital Geleceğini Bugünden Yönetin**

Günümüz üretim dünyasında rekabet artık yalnızca daha fazla üretmekle değil; daha verimli, daha
esnek, daha sürdürülebilir ve daha akıllı üretmekle mümkün hale gelmiştir. Küresel rekabetin
arttığı, müşteri beklentilerinin değiştiği ve teknolojik dönüşümün hızlandığı bu yeni dönemde üretim
tesislerinin gerçek zamanlı veri ile yönetilmesi kritik önem taşımaktadır.

MAS+, üretim operasyonlarının dijitalleştirilmesi, görünür hale getirilmesi ve sürekli
iyileştirilmesi amacıyla geliştirilmiş yeni nesil Akıllı Fabrika Platformudur.

Üretim sahasındaki makinelerden, operatörlerden ve kurumsal sistemlerden elde edilen verileri tek
bir platform altında bir araya getirerek işletmelere uçtan uca dijital üretim yönetimi imkanı sunar.

MAS+, yalnızca verileri toplamakla kalmaz; üretimi analiz eder, süreçleri optimize eder, karar alma
mekanizmalarını güçlendirir ve işletmelerin dijital dönüşüm yolculuğuna liderlik eder.

Üretim tesisleri her gün binlerce veri üretmektedir. Ancak bu verilerin anlamlı bilgiye

• Operasyonel görünürlüğü artırır

• Karar alma süreçlerini hızlandırır

## Почему SEO может НЕ работать?

Воспользуйтесь слайдером и узнайте о причинах, которые могут значительно снизить эффективность
поискового продвижения.
Не тот сегмент и/или гео

Часто бывает, что сайт продвигается по запросам, которые не имеют к нему отношения.

Не хватает терпения

Клиент неоправданно ждет взрывного роста через неделю или две. В данном случае – утверждение, что
SEO не работает – это скорее – нежелание дождаться, когда внесенные правки на сайт проиндексируются,
и сайт начнет постепенный рост в выдаче.

Я заплатил - работайте!

SEO – это работа над сайтом: как со стороны заказчика, так и со стороны подрядчика. Предоставить
текстовый и графический контент, согласовать структуру, макеты, тексты. Без вас мы не сможет внести
изменения на сайт.

Не готовность к изменениям

В процессе сотрудничества будут изменения дизайна продвигаемых страниц и их функционала. Будьте к
этому готовы и помогайте нам в этом. В текущих реалиях продвинуть сайт со скудным контентом
невозможно.

Недостаточный бюджет

Доработка сайта требует дополнительного бюджета – на программирование и верстку. Качественная работа
дизайнеров и разработчиков стоит денег – особенно на начальном этапе.

Я сам лучше вас знаю!

К сожалению, не знаете. Мы ценим ваше мнение и учитываем советы, но предоставьте нам право выбирать
стратегию. Доверьтесь нам, и вы увидите результаты. Мы гарантируем.

## Почему SEO может НЕ работать?

Воспользуйтесь слайдером и узнайте о причинах, которые могут значительно снизить эффективность
поискового продвижения.
Не тот сегмент и/или гео

Часто бывает, что сайт продвигается по запросам, которые не имеют к нему отношения.

Не хватает терпения

Клиент неоправданно ждет взрывного роста через неделю или две. В данном случае – утверждение, что
SEO не работает – это скорее – нежелание дождаться, когда внесенные правки на сайт проиндексируются,
и сайт начнет постепенный рост в выдаче.

Я заплатил - работайте!

SEO – это работа над сайтом: как со стороны заказчика, так и со стороны подрядчика. Предоставить
текстовый и графический контент, согласовать структуру, макеты, тексты. Без вас мы не сможет внести
изменения на сайт.

Не готовность к изменениям

В процессе сотрудничества будут изменения дизайна продвигаемых страниц и их функционала. Будьте к
этому готовы и помогайте нам в этом. В текущих реалиях продвинуть сайт со скудным контентом
невозможно.

Недостаточный бюджет

Доработка сайта требует дополнительного бюджета – на программирование и верстку. Качественная работа
дизайнеров и разработчиков стоит денег – особенно на начальном этапе.

Я сам лучше вас знаю!

К сожалению, не знаете. Мы ценим ваше мнение и учитываем советы, но предоставьте нам право выбирать
стратегию. Доверьтесь нам, и вы увидите результаты. Мы гарантируем.

## Frequently Asked Questions

Have a question? We might have an answer for you here

What is Lasmart?

Lasmart is a smart business analyst that improves the manageability of business processes and
provides the company’s leaders with the necessary information for effective solutions and long-term
growth.

What is business intelligence?

Business intelligence (BI) uncovers insights for making better, data-driven decisions. Business
intelligence tools collect, store and analyse data and present findings to create a comprehensive
view of a business. 

How business intelligence works

Step 1: Data sourcing for storing and management raw data

Step 2: Creating structure for further data analysis

Step 3: Data reporting and presenting it in an understandable way

Step 4: Taking action on insights in real-time

Step 5: Monitoring and prediction based on previous findings.

Can I use BI tools with my existing business tools and software?

BI tools work seamlessly with software that users are already familiar with. Make a list of the
commonly used tools that your BI software needs to connect with — make a list of apps, plug-ins and
connectors that your business regularly uses and send it over to us – we will prepare a personal
offer for you.

Why is a product display planogram necessary?

The main purpose of the shop floor plan is the efficient sale of goods and the distribution of
available space between tenants (suppliers of products). The planogram of the merchandise display is
already drawn up by the traders themselves and is intended for merchandisers. The main task of the
merchandising plan is to ensure a convenient and logical arrangement of products, a correctly
prepared planogram allows to make the process of window display maintenance more efficient and
contributes to an increase in sales volumes.

Which platforms do we work on?
1. **Microsoft**

Robust platform for enterprises with multiple sales channels, complex CRM system and large data
volume
2. **Qlik**

Associative model of data handling, built-in support for any mobile devices
3. **Superset**

Apache Superset — a software for research and the visualisation of data, built for large data sets.
4. **Prognoz**

Fulfills the requirements for industrial BI platforms, which allows for the creation of highly
sophisticated business applications in a form of turnkey solutions

### Business Maps

[Business Maps]

Turn any spreadsheet into a clear, decision-ready map. Visualize customers, prospects, and
competitors with color coding, heat maps, symbols, and charts — then share interactive maps across
your team.

[Learn more][62] START FREE

### Territory Management

[Territory Management]

Create and manage sales, service, or franchise territories from ZIP Codes, counties, or states.
Overlay customers, competitors, and reps. Reveal overlaps, balance workloads, and share interactive
territory maps with your team.

[Learn more][63] START FREE

### Market Analysis

[Market Analysis]

Discover growth opportunities with built-in demographics and business listings. Identify look-alike
markets, assess competitor presence, and use nearest-location analysis to support site selection and
targeted outreach.

[Learn more][64] START FREE

## Optimize Logistics

### Route Planning

[Route Planning]

Plan efficient multi-stop routes with automatic stop reordering, time windows, stop durations, and
turn-by-turn directions — then share with your team to cut travel costs and boost on-time
performance.

[Learn more][65] START FREE

### Drive Time Analysis

[Drive Time Analysis]

Create realistic drive-time polygons. Use them to build sales, service or delivery territories.
Select sites based on drive-time access. Find nearby customers, prospects, or competitors. Analyze
trade areas using demographics and business listings.

[Learn more][66] START FREE

## Map Data

### ZIP Codes and More

[ZIP Codes and More]

Display ZIP Code, county, state, and other administrative boundaries. Create territories, analyze
customer and sales data by geography, and use radius or drive-time areas for site analysis.

[Learn more][67] START FREE

[Demographic Data]

decisions.

[Business Listings]

[Batch Analysis Tools]

enrich records with demographic variables.

* **All-in-one mapping product**

## Learn How Our Customers are Succeeding with MapBusinessOnline

[Chris Farcher]

"*MapBusinessOnline is an amazing tool that I use every week. When you are creating zip code
footprints and trying to determine what zip codes fall within a range of a business, this tool
couldn't be any easier to use. There's actually so many functions that are great but specifically I
use MapBusinessOnline to create either a mile radius or a drive time radius from a business
location. I then use that radius to determine which zip codes fall within the radius. Why is this
important? Because I then export the zip codes and use another software that gets me exact counts of
how many people fall within that radius in those zip codes. It's Amazing!*

*I highly recommend this software!*"

Chris Farcher
Account Manager
The Mailworks

[Colette Bell]

"*I have had the pleasure of using MapBusinessOnline for the past 5 years and it is an excellent and
affordable tool for my clients. I am a franchise consultant, and many of my clients are just
starting to get into franchising. The first main question many of them have is they don’t know the
demographics around their current location, so they don’t know how to create territories for their
franchisees. I am able to easily utilize MapBusinessOnline to draw a prototype territory around
their existing location, do a deep dive into the many different demographics that MapBusinessOnline
offers, and help the client determine the basics of their new territories, including mileage,
population, household count, purchasing habits and age distributions. This tool has been so helpful
that many of our clients obtain their own accounts as they begin to sell franchises and grow their
business. Thank you, MapBusinessOnline, for providing such a helpful tool that is affordable and
easy to use!*"

Colette Bell
Director of Business Development
SMB Franchise Advisors

[Bill Hanavan]

"*I have been using MapBusinessOnline for about 8 months and couldn’t be happier with the services
it provides. I have employees and myself who map around 250 routes monthly for our sales team. The
interface is easy-to-use and the abilities are exactly what I need. My sales team finds the maps and
step by step routes easy to follow and accurate. My store lists change every quarter and the
uploading system allows me to quickly upload a new list and categorize the account by priority using
colors and shapes. I have also used the heat mapping capabilities and found those easy to customize
and quick to use. As with any advanced software, this does take a week or two to learn the more
complex features, but it is well worth the time invested. This is the software I would have designed
if I was to create one myself. Great job!!!*"

Bill Hanavan
Director of Operations
Strategic Retail Solutions

# Mapping Software for Business Intelligence

### Business Maps

[Business Maps]

Turn any spreadsheet into a clear, decision-ready map. Visualize customers, prospects, and
competitors with color coding, heat maps, symbols, and charts — then share interactive maps across
your team.

[Learn more][62] START FREE

### Territory Management

[Territory Management]

Create and manage sales, service, or franchise territories from ZIP Codes, counties, or states.
Overlay customers, competitors, and reps. Reveal overlaps, balance workloads, and share interactive
territory maps with your team.

[Learn more][63] START FREE

### Market Analysis

[Market Analysis]

Discover growth opportunities with built-in demographics and business listings. Identify look-alike
markets, assess competitor presence, and use nearest-location analysis to support site selection and
targeted outreach.

[Learn more][64] START FREE

## Optimize Logistics

### Route Planning

[Route Planning]

Plan efficient multi-stop routes with automatic stop reordering, time windows, stop durations, and
turn-by-turn directions — then share with your team to cut travel costs and boost on-time
performance.

[Learn more][65] START FREE

### Drive Time Analysis

[Drive Time Analysis]

Create realistic drive-time polygons. Use them to build sales, service or delivery territories.
Select sites based on drive-time access. Find nearby customers, prospects, or competitors. Analyze
trade areas using demographics and business listings.

[Learn more][66] START FREE

## Map Data

### ZIP Codes and More

[ZIP Codes and More]

Display ZIP Code, county, state, and other administrative boundaries. Create territories, analyze
customer and sales data by geography, and use radius or drive-time areas for site analysis.

[Learn more][67] START FREE

### Demographic Data

[Demographic Data]

Access demographic variables including population, age, income, and households. Enrich customer and
sales data, evaluate market potential, and compare territories to support targeting and expansion
decisions.

[Learn more][68] START FREE

### Business Listings

[Business Listings]

Search nationwide business listings by industry and location. Map competitors and prospects, build
targeted lead lists, and export results to support sales, marketing, and expansion efforts.

[Learn more][69] START FREE

### Batch Analysis Tools

[Batch Analysis Tools]

Run proximity and distance analysis at scale. Search and segment your data by distance. Assign
customers to the nearest store or site, calculate distances between dataset locations in bulk, and
enrich records with demographic variables.

[Learn more][70] START FREE

## Why Choose MapBusinessOnline
* **All-in-one mapping product**
  Provides insightful maps, territory management, market analysis, logistics optimization, and more
  — all in a single solution.
* **Rich data collection included at no cost**
  Enhance your maps with commercial-grade demographic, geographic, and business listing datasets.
* **Designed for business users**
  Built for sales, marketing, and operations teams — easy to use without GIS expertise.
* **Collaboration made easy**
  Empower teams to work from a shared map environment. Collaborate on territories, customer
  coverage, and market analysis, ensuring everyone has consistent data and a common view for
  planning, execution, and reporting.

Learn more

## Learn How Our Customers are Succeeding with MapBusinessOnline

[Chris Farcher]

"*MapBusinessOnline is an amazing tool that I use every week. When you are creating zip code
footprints and trying to determine what zip codes fall within a range of a business, this tool
couldn't be any easier to use. There's actually so many functions that are great but specifically I
use MapBusinessOnline to create either a mile radius or a drive time radius from a business
location. I then use that radius to determine which zip codes fall within the radius. Why is this
important? Because I then export the zip codes and use another software that gets me exact counts of
how many people fall within that radius in those zip codes. It's Amazing!*

*I highly recommend this software!*"

Chris Farcher
Account Manager
The Mailworks

[Colette Bell]

"*I have had the pleasure of using MapBusinessOnline for the past 5 years and it is an excellent and
affordable tool for my clients. I am a franchise consultant, and many of my clients are just
starting to get into franchising. The first main question many of them have is they don’t know the
demographics around their current location, so they don’t know how to create territories for their
franchisees. I am able to easily utilize MapBusinessOnline to draw a prototype territory around
their existing location, do a deep dive into the many different demographics that MapBusinessOnline
offers, and help the client determine the basics of their new territories, including mileage,
population, household count, purchasing habits and age distributions. This tool has been so helpful
that many of our clients obtain their own accounts as they begin to sell franchises and grow their
business. Thank you, MapBusinessOnline, for providing such a helpful tool that is affordable and
easy to use!*"

Colette Bell
Director of Business Development
SMB Franchise Advisors

[Bill Hanavan]

"*I have been using MapBusinessOnline for about 8 months and couldn’t be happier with the services
it provides. I have employees and myself who map around 250 routes monthly for our sales team. The
interface is easy-to-use and the abilities are exactly what I need. My sales team finds the maps and
step by step routes easy to follow and accurate. My store lists change every quarter and the
uploading system allows me to quickly upload a new list and categorize the account by priority using
colors and shapes. I have also used the heat mapping capabilities and found those easy to customize
and quick to use. As with any advanced software, this does take a week or two to learn the more
complex features, but it is well worth the time invested. This is the software I would have designed
if I was to create one myself. Great job!!!*"

Bill Hanavan
Director of Operations
Strategic Retail Solutions

data team can curate a governed semantic layer of canonical tables and metrics in Data Studio.

Metabot AI or connect to the MCP server, click on charts to find the "why" with built-in drilldowns,

customizable analytics components, with plumbing and permissions built in.

`import {

  InteractiveQuestion,
  defineEmbeddingSdkConfig

const config = defineEmbeddingSdkConfig({

grow.

### Customizable to fit your product

a low-code integration.

workflow evolves.

# Together, We Can Redefine Technology Through Accessible Design and Development

No matter how long it takes, we’ll ensure that everyone has an equal opportunity to innovation; one
website, one application at a time.

[Schedule a Consultation][1][Four people in a workplace are looking at the upper camera.]

Clients

## Together

**Our clients don’t just follow new regulations, they care about people.** They care about making
technology accessible to everyone so that their products and services can continue to have maximum
impact.

Services

## We Are Redefining Accessible Design and Development for Public and Private Organizations

At the intersection of Social Justice and Equality, Legal Recognition of Disability Rights, Business
Considerations, Legal Compliance and Public Service Accessibility, Human Rights and Ethical
Obligations is where we live.

**Our clients** are striving to meet accessibility compliance regulations and work diligently to
ensure their digital and physical environments are inclusive and usable for all individuals,
including those with disabilities.

**They focus on removing barriers and enhancing user experiences, aligning their services and
products with legal standards and ethical considerations to cater to a diverse and broader
audience.** This commitment reflects a dedication to social responsibility, legal compliance, and a
drive to create equitable access for everyone.

[Smiling person looks into the camera.]

Services

## Accessible Design and Development Services

[Accessibility Compliance Consulting Abstract Icon]

### Accessibility Compliance Consulting

Expert guidance to ensure your digital products meet legal and ethical accessibility standards.

[Accessible UX/UI Design Services Abstract Icon]

### Accessible UX/UI Design Services

Designing user interfaces and experiences that are intuitive and accessible for all users, including
those with disabilities.

[Digital Accessibility Implementation Abstract Icon]

### Digital Accessibility Implementation

Implementing accessibility features into digital products to enhance usability for a diverse user
base.

[Accessibility Compliance Documentation Abstract Icon]

### Accessibility Compliance Documentation

Creating comprehensive documentation to demonstrate and maintain compliance with accessibility
standards.

[Cross-Platform Accessibility Integration Abstract Icon]

### Cross-Platform Accessibility Integration

Ensuring consistent accessibility across various platforms and devices for a seamless user
experience.

[Staff Augmentation Abstract Icon]

### Staff Augmentation

Providing skilled professionals to supplement your team in creating accessible digital products.

[Accessible Web Development Abstract Icon]

### Accessible Web Development

Specializing in creating websites that are fully accessible, following WCAG guidelines to ensure
usability for all users, including those with disabilities.

[Mobile Accessibility Development Abstract Icon]

### Mobile Accessibility Development

Developing mobile applications with accessibility in mind, ensuring they are usable by people with

Currently, I am using meta-analysis to look for “original discoveries and contributions by mining
the untapped veins of information in accumulated research literatures.” ([Hunter & Schmidt 2004,
p. 21][6])

In general, I believe that research is inherently cross-disciplinary:
* Data science helps us to distill interesting patterns from human behavior.
* Qualitative research helps us to understand the meaning of these patterns.
* Experimental research and design research help us to use this understanding to build more
  effective information systems.

* Data Science
* Qualitative Document Analysis
* Philosophy of Science

## From numbers to narratives East African finance decoded

Mwango Capital is an East African based financial research firm that leverages digital media to
deliver expert insights on East Africa’s financial markets. We empower investors with clear,
fact-based analysis of company financials, market dynamics, and policy developments. Through
rigorous research, high‑quality media production, and expert commentary, we inform retail and
institutional audiences across the region. We publish **The Mwango Weekly** newsletter every Monday,
host **#MwangoSpaces** every Thursday, and release new **#MwangoMemes** every Sunday. Our analyses
are deeply contextual, grounded in East African realities with a natural focus on Kenya.

## Trusted by Leading Brands
## Used by Over 2000 Companies

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking

## Trusted by Leading Brands
## Used by Over 2000 Companies

## Do you really know who you’re dealing with?

We enter into contracts with companies every day. Each of those contracts was with something with
legal personality – almost always a "legal entity". Yet too often we're ignorant of them and who is
behind them, with all the attendant risks that brings.

Whether you're in business, government, journalism, activism, research or a consumer — [our
goal][39] is to help you better understand the companies you deal with.

Search the world’s largest open legal-entity database or plug the data direct into your applications
and processes.

Fresh, standardized, auditable information underpinned by our [Legal-Entity Data Principles][40],
this is data you can trust.

[ Search now ][41]
[ Plug in our data ][42]

## It shouldn't be hard to get legal-entity data you can trust

And yet it is. Legal-entity information is dispersed across hundreds of business registers that are
hard to navigate and impossible to access at scale. Traditional company-data aggregators are no
longer the answer either, given their opaque processes and provenance.

Verifiable accuracy is more important than ever, and you should expect more.

You need data built on deep expertise, rigorous data models and [well-founded, forward-looking
principles][43]. Data sourced direct from primary sources, curated with clear decision-making and no
hidden bias, and defined by open not proprietary identifiers and standards. Data you know you can
trust.

[ Search now ][44]
[ Plug in our data ][45]

## OpenCorporates was born out of the same frustrations you experience every day

We believe a fairer, more prosperous and sustainable society can only be achieved with greater
corporate transparency.

Since 2010 we’ve been working with government agencies, NGOs and public-benefit groups to improve
the quality and accessibility of the foundational legal-entity data on which you depend.

Today we offer the world's largest open legal-entity database, providing a single unified set of 
company records from over 140 government registries and other official sources around the world.

# Data Mining Fruitful and Fun

Open source machine learning and data visualization.

[Download Orange 3.40.0][8]

May 08, 2026

## [Gairdin: Traditional Slovenian Houses - Reinvented][9]

Students can now explore Slovenian houses in a completely unplugged way.

[[Gairdin: Traditional Slovenian Houses - Reinvented]][10]

Apr 14, 2026

### [Gairdin: Gnomes with the Youngest Students][11]

We explored what the gnomes are doing together with the youngest primary school students and had a
lot of fun along the way.

[[Gairdin: Gnomes with the Youngest Students]][12]

Dec 31, 2025

### [Orange Essentials: Interactive Workflows][13]

A new YouTube tutorial shows how to turn Orange into an interactive data exploration tool.

[[Orange Essentials: Interactive Workflows]][14]

Dec 24, 2025

### [Orange Essentials: Annotating Workflows][15]

A new YouTube tutorial shows how to annotate workflows in Orange.

[[Orange Essentials: Annotating Workflows]][16]

## Visual Programming

No coding needed. Place widgets on the canvas, connect them, load your datasets, and harvest the
insight!

[ Learn more][17][Watch video][18]

## Interactive Data Visualization

Explore statistical distributions, box plots and scatter plots, or dive deeper with decision trees,
hierarchical clustering, heatmaps, MDS, t-SNE and linear projections. Even your multidimensional
data can make sense.

[ Learn more][19]

## Extensions

Specialized add-ons can perform natural language processing and text mining, conduct network
analysis, do association rules mining, or address fairness in machine learning. Some address
specialized data, such as time series, survival data sets, spectra, or gene expressions. Also, check
out Orange's cousin [Quasar][20].

[Watch video][21]

## Teach with Orange

When teaching data mining, we like to illustrate rather than only explain. And Orange is great at
that. Used at schools, universities and in professional training courses across the world, Orange
supports hands-on training and visual illustrations of concepts from data science. There are even
widgets that were especially designed for teaching.

[Learn more][22]

My laboratory produces large amounts of data from RNA-seq, ChIP-seq and genome resequencing
experiments.  Orange allows me to analyze my data even though I don’t know how to program.  It also
allows me to communicate with my collaborators, who are experts in data mining, and with my
colleagues and trainees.

**Gad Shaulsky, Ph.D.**

Molecular biologist and Director of Graduate Studies (Baylor College of Medicine, Houston, USA)

The scientific community is in need of tools that allow easy construction of workflows and
visualizations and are capable of analyzing large amounts of data. Orange is a powerful platform to
perform data analysis and visualization, see data flow and become more productive. It provides a
clean, open source platform and the possibility to add further functionality for all fields of
science.

**Ferenc Borondics, Ph.D.**

Principal beamline scientist at SMIS (SOLEIL synchrotron, France)

I teach Orange workshops monthly to a diverse audience, from undergrad students to expert
researchers. Orange is very intuitive, and, by the end of the workshop, the participants are able to
perform complex data visualization and basic machine learning analyses. Most of our attendees have
been able to incorporate this tool in their research practice.

**Francesca Vitali, Ph.D.**

Research Assistant Professor (Center for Biomedical Informatics & Biostatistics, The University of
Arizona)

## Contribute to Orange

If you love using Orange and want to support us, a donation would be very much appreciated. The
funds help us fix bugs, implement new features, provide free educational content, and maintain
computational infrastructure.
