### Frequently asked questions

Are the writers qualified and experienced in the relevant subject area?
Yes, our writers are highly qualified and experienced in their relevant subject areas. We have a
rigorous selection process to ensure that only knowledgeable experts handle the assignments.
What is the process for requesting and receiving completed assignments?
The process for requesting and receiving completed assignments is simple and convenient. Students
can submit their assignment details and requirements through our online platform. Our system matches
the assignment with the most suitable writer, who then works on it within the agreed-upon timeframe.
Once completed, the assignment is delivered securely through the platform for the student to review
and download.
Can the writing service meet tight deadlines?
Yes, our writing service is capable of meeting tight deadlines. We understand that students often
have assignments with time constraints, and we strive to accommodate those needs. Our team of
writers is accustomed to working under pressure and delivering high-quality work within the
specified deadlines.
How does the service ensure originality and prevent plagiarism?
We ensure originality and prevent plagiarism by employing expert writers who create unique content
for each assignment. Our rigorous quality assurance process, including the use of plagiarism
detection tools, further guarantees the authenticity of the work delivered to our clients.
How does the service handle confidential and sensitive information?
The service takes the handling of confidential and sensitive information very seriously. We have
strict privacy and security measures in place to protect our clients' data. We adhere to industry
standards and best practices for data protection. All personal and assignment-related information
shared with us is treated with the utmost confidentiality and is securely stored. We do not disclose
or share any client information with third parties unless required by law. Your privacy and the
security of your information are of paramount importance to us.

What is Flourish?
Flourish is a powerful data visualization platform that empowers the world to tell stories with
data. Trusted by organizations and newsrooms worldwide, Flourish helps creators bring data
narratives to life with highly engaging, interactive and impressive visualizations. Our extensive
library of templates and seamless embedding options make every data story informative and truly
captivating.


Who is behind Flourish?
Flourish was co-founded in 2018 by [Duncan Clark and Robin Houston][42]. Duncan has a background in
data journalism and publishing, while Robin is a mathematician and developer. In 2022, Canva
acquired Flourish with the shared goal of democratizing data storytelling and making data
visualization accessible to all. Read more about this [here][43].


How does Flourish differ from other data visualization tools?
Flourish sets itself apart through:
* **Ease of use**: No specific technical skills are needed thanks to its template-based system and
  intuitive user interface.
* **Storytelling**: Flourish is uniquely designed to facilitate narrative visualizations, such as
  scrollytelling, interactive presentations, and audio-driven stories.
* **Flexibility**: The Flourish SDK lets developers create custom templates without limitations on
  functionality or design.
* **Publishability**: All outputs are styled for robustness, capable of reaching unlimited
  audiences, and optimized for mobile viewing.


Is Flourish a business intelligence tool?
Flourish is not typically regarded as a business intelligence tool. While its templates and
[API][44] allow for data exploration and dashboard integration, its primary focus is on data
storytelling, especially for presentations and digital publications.

## Let’s connect

Ready to transform your work with data storytelling? Connect with our team to learn more and get

What is Flourish?
Flourish is a powerful data visualization platform that empowers the world to tell stories with
data. Trusted by organizations and newsrooms worldwide, Flourish helps creators bring data
narratives to life with highly engaging, interactive and impressive visualizations. Our extensive
library of templates and seamless embedding options make every data story informative and truly
captivating.


Who is behind Flourish?
Flourish was co-founded in 2018 by [Duncan Clark and Robin Houston][42]. Duncan has a background in
data journalism and publishing, while Robin is a mathematician and developer. In 2022, Canva
acquired Flourish with the shared goal of democratizing data storytelling and making data
visualization accessible to all. Read more about this [here][43].


How does Flourish differ from other data visualization tools?
Flourish sets itself apart through:
* **Ease of use**: No specific technical skills are needed thanks to its template-based system and
  intuitive user interface.
* **Storytelling**: Flourish is uniquely designed to facilitate narrative visualizations, such as
  scrollytelling, interactive presentations, and audio-driven stories.
* **Flexibility**: The Flourish SDK lets developers create custom templates without limitations on
  functionality or design.
* **Publishability**: All outputs are styled for robustness, capable of reaching unlimited
  audiences, and optimized for mobile viewing.


Is Flourish a business intelligence tool?
Flourish is not typically regarded as a business intelligence tool. While its templates and
[API][44] allow for data exploration and dashboard integration, its primary focus is on data
storytelling, especially for presentations and digital publications.

# About Our Company

The leader in financial operations and performance management solutions, Qvinci helps hundreds of

measure, monitor, and communicate financial performance in a manner everyone understands, can make
sense of, and act on. The result is an organization-wide culture of transparency, collaboration,
profitability, compliance, and expansive growth.

## Qvinci + QuickBooks = The Smart Choice

If you’re managing multiple entities, clients, or locations and are struggling with reporting,
consolidation, or forecasting, you may have been told it’s time to move on from QuickBooks. But
here’s the truth: You don’t need to switch. You just need to connect QuickBooks to Qvinci. Qvinci
adds the advanced advisory and reporting capabilities growing organizations need without the cost,

locations.

decision-making.

This feature allows users to assess and compare the performance of their locations, identifying

or growth.

## *Built for speed.* Engineered for trust.

### Days of analysis, done in seconds.

Rill's AI agent runs dozens of queries to find the "why" behind your numbers so anyone can explore
large datasets without waiting on an analyst.

### One source of truth for your team and agents.

Establish a single, consistent version of truth for everyone in your organization through a "define
once, use everywhere" approach.

### Embedded analytics that match your brand.

Securely embed dashboards and data visualizations into your own applications, fully customizable to
match your company's colors, typography, and identity.

## One platform to *act* on data

01

### Get answers to any question

Ask open-ended questions using natural language to receive a visual, verifiable answer. Easily
enhance the AI's insights with your own expertise, seamlessly integrating machine and human
intelligence with a single click.

02

### Explore and explain data

Gain quick insights into metric shifts and identify data anomalies with comprehensive summaries of
their underlying root causes. Interactive dashboards allow users to intuitively filter, drill down,
and compare data for deeper exploration.

03

### Scale with BI-as-code

Define and govern all your BI assets as SQL and YAML code in a GitHub project. Go from data to
deployed dashboards using Claude or Cursor in minutes.

04

### Customize your dashboards

Canvas dashboards let you define your own visualizations and arrange them into your preferred
layout. You can display data, create visualizations, and add rich content from independent metrics
views.

05

### Embed analytics with style

Integrate custom-themed dashboards, with matching colors and typography, directly into your product.
Securely embed data and analytics to increase the value of your offerings.

[Equipment rental-dashboard]

#### Reporting for Rental Businesses

Use data-driven insights to balance profitability with customer demands. TARGIT’s all-in-one BI
solution makes it easy to track key metrics like rental financial utilization rate, equipment
health, and overall fleet performance with automated reports and dashboards. Learn more
about [Equipment Rental Solutions][113]
[Heavy Equipment]

#### Informed Decisions in Every Department

Combine data from your DMS, ERP, and every other business system to get a complete view of your
operations. Create daily reports and dashboards for sales, service, finance, and more, then compare
performance between multiple locations. Learn more about [Heavy Equipment Solutions][114]
[Manufacturing-dashboard]

#### Insights Across Your Supply Chain

TARGIT’s BI solution gives you complete visibility and control over the entire manufacturing line.
Use automated reports to analyze performance and inform decisions that boost overall equipment
efficiency, decrease recall risk, and optimize operating costs. Learn more about [Manufacturing
Solutions][115]
[Material Handling-dashboard]

#### All-In-One BI Solution

Monitor performance and drive results across your dealership with daily reports and interactive
dashboards. Streamline performance management with TARGIT’s intuitive, all-in-one BI solution for
material handling equipment dealerships. Learn more about [Material Handling Solutions][116]
[Public Sector-1]

#### BI for the Public Sector

Increase efficiency and reduce administrative workload without compromising data quality. TARGIT
gives you a comprehensive view of your operations so you can make informed decisions at your
library, healthcare facility, educational institute, or government organization. Learn more about
[Public Sector Solutions][117]
[Truck & Trailer-dashboard]

#### End-to-End Reporting for Dealers

Create automated reports and dashboards based on data from your DMS, payroll system, ERP platform,
and any other tool you use to run your dealership. Then, use TARGIT’s user-friendly interface to
equip everyone with the latest performance insights. Learn more about [Truck & Trailer
Solutions][118]

**Get a complete picture of your data with automated reports and dashboards built for your

## Solutions Tailored to Your Industry & Platform

At TARGIT, we tailor our software to customers’ goals, requirements, and unique business
environments by pairing our business intelligence (BI) expertise with a distinct focus on specific
industries and operating platforms. 

This approach ensures that our customers realize lasting value from their BI implementations and
receive strategic support and guidance from our team of experts every step of the way.

#### Reporting for Car Dealerships

Gain unparalleled insight into your operating results with a reporting solution built exclusively
for auto dealers. Our user-friendly, all-in-one solution gives you instant visibility into the
numbers behind your operations, with intuitive reports for sales, after-sales, finance, and more.
Learn more about [Automotive Solutions][112] 
[Equipment rental-dashboard]

#### Reporting for Rental Businesses

Use data-driven insights to balance profitability with customer demands. TARGIT’s all-in-one BI
solution makes it easy to track key metrics like rental financial utilization rate, equipment
health, and overall fleet performance with automated reports and dashboards. Learn more
about [Equipment Rental Solutions][113]
[Heavy Equipment]

#### Informed Decisions in Every Department

Combine data from your DMS, ERP, and every other business system to get a complete view of your
operations. Create daily reports and dashboards for sales, service, finance, and more, then compare
performance between multiple locations. Learn more about [Heavy Equipment Solutions][114]
[Manufacturing-dashboard]

#### Insights Across Your Supply Chain

TARGIT’s BI solution gives you complete visibility and control over the entire manufacturing line.
Use automated reports to analyze performance and inform decisions that boost overall equipment
efficiency, decrease recall risk, and optimize operating costs. Learn more about [Manufacturing
Solutions][115]
[Material Handling-dashboard]

#### All-In-One BI Solution

Monitor performance and drive results across your dealership with daily reports and interactive
dashboards. Streamline performance management with TARGIT’s intuitive, all-in-one BI solution for
material handling equipment dealerships. Learn more about [Material Handling Solutions][116]
[Public Sector-1]

#### BI for the Public Sector

Increase efficiency and reduce administrative workload without compromising data quality. TARGIT
gives you a comprehensive view of your operations so you can make informed decisions at your
library, healthcare facility, educational institute, or government organization. Learn more about
[Public Sector Solutions][117]
[Truck & Trailer-dashboard]

#### End-to-End Reporting for Dealers

Create automated reports and dashboards based on data from your DMS, payroll system, ERP platform,
and any other tool you use to run your dealership. Then, use TARGIT’s user-friendly interface to
equip everyone with the latest performance insights. Learn more about [Truck & Trailer
Solutions][118]

### Execution Layer for Distribution Revenue

surfaces where your existing customers could be buying more from you.

Repeat business, capital projects, large bids — tracked together in one system with one shared view.
No more status updates that are already stale before you ask for them.

team acts — not where they record what already happened.

priorities. Coverage improves. Handoffs get cleaner. Nothing falls through.

quickly find important insights within your data and make impactful business decisions. Wyn also
helps to save you money with a simple and scalable licensing model.

# No Code Embedded Business Intelligence Platform

## Visualize Your Data. Unlock Your Story.

**Your data has a story to tell. When you’re able to see the whole story, it all makes sense**

Wyn Enterprise is a business intelligence tool that empowers your users with self-service BI to
quickly find important insights within your data and make impactful business decisions. Wyn also
helps to save you money with a simple and scalable licensing model.

[ Try Wyn For Free ][103]
What is your data telling you?

## Wyn Enterprise
## is Built for Embedded BI

Data is a business’ most valuable resource. With Wyn Enterprise, you can go from data to insights in
minutes. Watch this 3-minute video to see how Wyn makes this possible!

[ Try Wyn For Free ][104]
For whom

## Embedded BI for Your Business or Commercial SaaS App

Whether it’s your business or your commercial SaaS app, embed Wyn and empower users to design,
share, and distribute dashboards and reports.
[ Try Wyn For Free ][105]
BI for Software Vendors

Embed BI, advanced analytics, and distributed reporting into any multi-tenant SaaS application with
no per-user fees or data limitations.

[ Learn more ][106]
BI for Your Organization

Empower all end-users to become data-driven. Build a variety of KPIs and dynamic report metrics, all
from an embedded business intelligence environment.

[ Learn more ][107]
Enterprise Licensing

## Simple & Scalable
## Licensing

You need a scalable business intelligence tool. You also need to know how much it will cost in the
long run.

Wyn’s server-based licensing allows room for business growth without an increase in user fees.
Server-based licensing allows you to scale your business and the user base — with no additional
cost.

[ Price Request ][108]

### No Per-User Fees

Add as many users as needed without worrying about rising costs.

### No Data Limitations

Unlimited data handling with seamless performance and no capacity constraints.

### Low total cost of ownership

Reduce costs and boost efficiency with our solutions, maximizing your investment.

Post-purchase, exit-intent & on-site surveys your customers actually answer, _

#### Zigpoll is the trusted feedback partner for 20,000+ companies.

### Go Live in 5 Minutes — Seriously

Step 1
Install Our Shopify App or Add Our Embed Code

One-click Shopify install. Works with any website too.

Step 2
Set Up Surveys in 5 Minutes

Pick from proven templates or build your own. Most stores go live in under 3 minutes.

Step 3
Get Automated Insights

AI analyzes responses automatically. Get actionable insights, not just data.

[Get Started Now][21] Or [Check Our Pricing][22]

#### Turn Every Interaction Into Revenue

###### Get answers that drive real business decisions.

###### Ask smarter questions.

10+ question types designed to maximize engagement. Our customers see a **50% average response
rate** - 10x the industry standard.

Use **branching logic** to dig deeper on specific answers. Offer **discounts or incentives** to
boost completion rates.

[Start Free][23]

###### Get insights instantly.

Our AI analyzes responses in real-time and surfaces **actionable insights** the moment patterns
emerge.

Ask questions in plain English. Our **AI assistant** knows your data and delivers answers in
seconds, not hours.

[Start Free][24]

###### Engage at the perfect time.

Target by behavior, purchase history, or customer segment. Trigger surveys from **Shopify events**,
**Klaviyo flows**, or **custom rules**.

Deliver via **email, SMS, or on-site popups**. Personalize every message with customer data.

[Start Free][25]

### Run Synthetic Market Research

###### Instant Answers From Any Audience

Step 1
Create Your Survey

Build your survey with any question types, branching logic, and display conditions.

Step 2
Create Your Audience

Define detailed audience profiles or pick from 9+ ready-made templates.

Step 3
Collect Responses

Get hundreds of completions in minutes with a 100% completion rate.

##### Target Any Audience

Build detailed audience profiles with demographics, interests, and behaviors, or pick from
ready-made templates like Gen Z, Enterprise Decision Makers, and more.

##### Instant Results

Get hundreds of survey completions in minutes. No more waiting weeks for responses or struggling
with low response rates.

##### Respects Survey Logic

AI respondents follow your branching rules, skip logic, and display conditions, just like real
participants would.

##### Test Before You Launch

Validate question wording, catch broken flows, and preview your dashboard, all before a single real
customer sees your survey.

##### 94+ Languages

Generate responses in any language your customers speak. Research international markets without
translation overhead.

##### Full Analytics

Synthetic responses feed directly into Zigpoll's analytics, charts, and AI insights. The same tools
you use for real data.

[Try Synthetic Now][26] Or [Learn More][27]

### Ready to get started?

###### Free forever. No credit card. Cancel anytime.

[Create My First Survey][28] Or [Install on Shopify][29]

### Latest Case Studies

### Frequently Asked Questions
* ###### What is Zigpoll?
  
  Zigpoll is a contextual micro-survey tool. The idea is that you create small interactive surveys
  that show up where and when you want them on your website. The data you gather from surveys polls
  can then be used for lots of different things, like making your business better, increasing your
  conversion rate, and generating new leads.
* ###### How is Zigpoll different from Hotjar or other survey tools?
  
  Zigpoll is built specifically for eCommerce. We integrate directly with Shopify, trigger surveys
  based on purchase events, and connect your responses to actual customer data — not anonymous
  visitors. This means you can tie feedback directly to order value, customer segments, and lifetime
  value.
* ###### Will this slow down my site?
  
  No. Our script is under 20KB and loads asynchronously. It won't affect your Core Web Vitals or
  page speed scores.
* ###### What's included in the free plan?
  
  Zigpoll Lite is free forever and includes unlimited surveys, up to 100 responses per month, all
  question types, basic integrations, and email support. No credit card required to start. You can
  upgrade anytime to unlock unlimited responses, advanced integrations, and AI-powered insights.
* ###### Can I have multiple surveys on my website?
  
  Yes. You can have as many surveys as you want on your website. You can only show one survey per
  page though.
* ###### Can I put a specific survey on a specific page of my website?
  
  Yes. You can specify what pages you want a survey to show up on using our Page Rules. You can
  exclude certain pages, or match certain pages based on a variety of options. If you have trouble
  getting a survey on a certain page, email us and we'll be happy to help: [[email protected]][51].
* ###### Does this work for all websites?
  
  Yes. All you need to do is copy the embed code and place it within the head tag of your website
  and you will be all set. If you need help putting the code in, we are always here to help, just
  send us an email here: [[email protected]][52].
* ###### Can I customize my Zigpoll?
  
  Yes. You can change all the colors of your Zigpoll using the display tab. Each survey can have a
  different color scheme if you prefer.
* ###### Can I customize when my Zigpoll shows up?
  
  Yes. You can control where and when the survey shows up using the visibility tab. You can control
  each survey separately or all of them in bulk if you prefer.
* ###### Can I customize how many times the survey shows up?
  
  Yes. You can control how many times a user sees a survey using the visibility tab. You can also
  control if the survey hides immediately or if it continues to show up after it has been completed.
* ###### Can I get in touch with you for custom support?
  
  Absolutely! We pride ourselves on having world class support. Send an email to
  [[email protected]][53] or use our [contact form][54] and we will get in touch ASAP no matter what
  plan you are on or your request.
